channel.title: Crypto Record
channel.description: Crypto Record reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto market.

item.title: Polygon Bridge: How Tokens Move Between Ethereum and Polygon
item.description: Polygon Bridge moves supported tokens between Ethereum and Polygon PoS by locking and minting on deposits, then burning and claiming on withdrawals.

item.title: BaseSwap: What Confirms a Transfer Before Tokens Arrive
item.description: A BaseSwap transfer is confirmed when Base records a successful transaction and its token logs; wallet display can lag while the balance is already on-chain.

item.title: Why Your Arbitrum Swap Is Pending or Failing
item.description: An Arbitrum swap can wait before the network accepts it or revert after execution; check its nonce, gas balance, slippage and route to find the cause.

item.title: UK banks move tokenised deposits across shared platform
item.description: Seven UK banks completed live tokenised-deposit payments on shared infrastructure, testing programmable bank money for remortgages and conditional consumer purchases.
